hero_eyebrow: A historic space with a modern spirit
hero_lede: The bar is in the package and the kitchen is ready for your caterer. There is a commercial kitchen in the building and a full bar in the Lobby, so nothing arrives cold and nobody queues in a hallway. You choose who cooks; the Den 1880 team coordinates them on the day.
objection_1_a: You choose your caterer, and they cook in the building's commercial kitchen instead of trucking food in. Need a name? Gourmet Chef at Your Table has cooked here, and a past client named them unprompted in their review of the night.
objection_2_a: A staffed bar in the Lobby, included in the package rather than billed separately. Bar enhancements are an add-on if you want something particular poured.
objection_3_a: Your caterer builds the menu with you, so restrictions get designed in during planning instead of improvised on the night.
food_intro: What the building brings, and where your caterer fits in.
food_1_body: Bring the caterer you love, or ask the events team for the preferred vendor sheet. Gourmet Chef at Your Table has cooked here before and was named by a past client in their review of the night.
food_2_body: A staffed bar in the Lobby, part of the package. Bar enhancements are available as an add-on if you want something specific poured.
food_3_body: A commercial kitchen inside the building for your caterer to work from. The difference between food that arrives hot and food that has travelled.
food_4_body: Your caterer builds the menu with you, so restrictions get handled in the planning rather than improvised on the night.

why_1_body: An 1880 heritage building with original wood, ornate chandeliers, marble and coloured lighting. Your décor only has to add the personal touches.
why_2_body: Venue, open bar, coordination, AV, furniture, staff and parking quoted together. One team, one invoice, one point of contact.
